title: SSC CGL Tier-1 Full Mock Test 07 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CGL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CGL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Book : Author :: Symphony : ?
questions.explanation: Book is created by an author; a symphony is created by a composer.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Telescope : Stars :: Microscope : ?
questions.explanation: Telescope is used to observe stars; microscope is used to observe germs.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 3, 8, 18, 38, 78, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If PAPER is coded as QBQFS, how is PENCIL coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: P→Q, E→F, N→O, C→D, I→J, L→M.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain code, ROAD is written as URDG. How is SWAN written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +3: S→V, W→Z, A→D, N→Q.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to the man?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son is the man's father; his daughter is the man's sister.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: D is A's maternal grandfather, so A is D's granddaughter.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 10 km north, then 6 km east, then 10 km south. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: North and south cancel; he is 6 km east of start.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Ravi starts walking towards East. After 20 m he turns left, walks 15 m, turns left again and walks 20 m. He then turns right and walks 10 m. In which direction is he from the start?
questions.explanation: After two lefts he faces West then right faces North; net displacement is North.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All pens are books. Some books are papers. Conclusions: I. Some pens are papers. II. Some papers are books.
questions.explanation: I does not necessarily follow; II follows from 'some books are papers'.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All cats are dogs. All dogs are rats. Conclusions: I. All cats are rats. II. Some rats are cats.
questions.explanation: All cats are rats and therefore some rats are cats. Both follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: 121, 144, 169, 196, 225, 256, 288
questions.explanation: All others are perfect squares (11^2 to 16^2); 288 is not.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Pluto
questions.explanation: Pluto is a dwarf planet, others are planets of the inner/solar system traditionally listed as planets.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends P,Q,R,S,T sit in a row facing north. P is second to the left of R. S is to the immediate right of R. T is at one of the ends. Q is not next to T. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order: T,P,R,S,Q or similar valid: middle is R.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a class of 40 students, Ravi ranks 12th from the top and 29th from the bottom. How many students are there between Ravi and the last rank if data is consistent?
questions.explanation: From bottom 29th means 28 after him towards last.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents: Doctors, Surgeons, Humans?
questions.explanation: All surgeons are doctors and all doctors are humans.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If the word 'PRISM' is seen in a mirror placed to the right of the word, the first letter from the left in the image is?
questions.explanation: Mirror reverses left-right so last letter M appears first.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2025?
questions.explanation: 2024 to 2025 is not a leap-day crossing after Aug, so +1 weekday → Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock are the hands of a clock together?
questions.explanation: Together at 3 : 16 4/11 minutes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All that glitters is not gold. Conclusions: I. Gold does not glitter. II. Something that glitters may not be gold.
questions.explanation: The proverb means glittering things need not be gold.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If + means × and × means +, then 8 + 3 × 4 = ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once along the diagonal and a hole is punched at the centre of one half. How many holes appear when unfolded?
questions.explanation: One fold along diagonal yields 2 holes on unfolding.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which of the following figures is embedded in a regular hexagon?
questions.explanation: A regular hexagon contains 6 equilateral triangles.

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Maurya Empire?
questions.explanation: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire with Chanakya's help.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: Battle of Plassey, 23 June 1757.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Equality?
questions.explanation: Article 14 guarantees equality before law.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The President of India is elected by?
questions.explanation: President is elected by an Electoral College of MPs and MLAs.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which is the longest river in India?
questions.explanation: Ganga is the longest river flowing in India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states; Odisha is not among them.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: RBI was established in which year?
questions.explanation: Reserve Bank of India was established in 1935.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: GST in India was implemented from?
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The chemical formula of washing soda is?
questions.explanation: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which vitamin is produced in the human body on exposure to sunlight?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: SI unit of electric current is?
questions.explanation: Ampere is the SI unit of current.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: G20 Summit 2023 was hosted by which country?
questions.explanation: India hosted the G20 Summit in New Delhi in 2023.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Bharat Ratna in 2024 was awarded to?
questions.explanation: Karpoori Thakur was conferred Bharat Ratna in 2024 along with others announced that year.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: How many players are there in a basketball team on the court?
questions.explanation: Five players per team on court.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Bharatanatyam is a classical dance of which state?
questions.explanation: Bharatanatyam originated in Tamil Nadu.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The headquarters of UNEP is at?
questions.explanation: United Nations Environment Programme HQ is in Nairobi.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who wrote 'Discovery of India'?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru wrote The Discovery of India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: One byte equals how many bits?
questions.explanation: 1 byte = 8 bits.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: INS Vikrant is a?
questions.explanation: INS Vikrant is India's indigenous aircraft carrier.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The national aquatic animal of India is?
questions.explanation: Ganges River Dolphin is the national aquatic animal.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who introduced the Doctrine of Lapse?
questions.explanation: Lord Dalhousie introduced the Doctrine of Lapse.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: How many Fundamental Duties are there in the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Originally 10; 11th added by 86th Amendment.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to iron oxide.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: pH of pure water at 25°C is?
questions.explanation: Neutral water has pH 7 at 25°C.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: NITI Aayog replaced which body?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part with error: He / do not / like tea / No error
questions.explanation: Subject 'He' needs 'does not'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The team / are playing / well today / No error
questions.explanation: Collective noun 'team' usually takes singular 'is playing'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is good _____ mathematics.
questions.explanation: Good at a subject.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He insisted _____ paying the bill.
questions.explanation: Insist on + gerund.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Synonym of ABANDON is?
questions.explanation: Abandon means forsake or leave.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Synonym of METICULOUS is?
questions.explanation: Meticulous means extremely careful.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Antonym of GENEROUS is?
questions.explanation: Generous opposite is stingy/miserly.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Antonym of TRANSPARENT is?
questions.explanation: Transparent opposite is opaque.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'A blessing in disguise' means?
options: Something good that seemed bad at first
questions.explanation: An apparent misfortune that results in something good.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'Bite the bullet' means?
questions.explanation: Face a painful task with courage.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who loves books is called?
questions.explanation: Bibliophile is a lover of books.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Government by the people is called?
questions.explanation: Democracy = rule by the people.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change to passive: They built this bridge in 1990.
questions.explanation: Past simple active → was/were + V3.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Change to indirect.
options: He said that he was tired.
He said that I am tired.
He said that he is tired.
He told that he was tired.
questions.explanation: Present changes to past in reported speech.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The sun _____ in the east.
questions.explanation: Sun rises (habitual present).

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is senior than me. Improve.
questions.explanation: Senior/junior take 'to', not 'than'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Arrange: P. to succeed Q. hard work R. is essential S. in life
questions.explanation: Hard work is essential to succeed in life → Q R P S.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is Embarrass.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The book is _____ the table.
questions.explanation: On the table.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: By next year she _____ her degree.
questions.explanation: Future perfect for action finished by a future time.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: _____ honest man is respected.
questions.explanation: Honest starts with vowel sound → An.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The manager called off the meeting. 'Called off' means?
questions.explanation: Call off = cancel.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Theme of a passage on climate change is most likely?
questions.explanation: Climate change passages typically discuss global warming.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Work hard _____ you will fail.
questions.explanation: Or / otherwise sense: work hard or you will fail.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Meaning of 'Ephemeral' is?
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time.
